test_title: PYST 42 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: P, Q and R working alone can complete a work in 24, 30 and 40 days respectively. All three of them started the work together but after 8 days P left the work. Q left the work 6 days before the work was completed. R completed the remaining work alone. In how many days was the total work completed?
solution:
**Given:**

P time = 24 days

Q time = 30 days

R time = 40 days

P works for 8 days

Q leaves 6 days before completion

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = 1 ÷ Time

Total work = Sum of individual works

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 24, 30, 40 = 120

⇒ Rate P = 5 ÷ 120

⇒ Rate Q = 4 ÷ 120

⇒ Rate R = 3 ÷ 120

⇒ Work by (P + Q + R) in 8 days = (5 + 4 + 3) &
